mapper.select: SELECT USER_ID AS userId, USER_NAME AS userName, NICKNAME AS nickname, EMAIL AS email, PHONE AS phone, ZIPCODE AS zipcode, USER_ADDR AS userAddr, FULL_ADDR AS fullAddr FROM users WHERE USER_ID = #{userId}
mapper.update: UPDATE users SET USER_NAME = #{userName}, NICKNAME = #{nickname}, EMAIL = #{email}, PHONE = #{phone}, ZIPCODE = #{zipcode}, USER_ADDR = #{userAddr}, FULL_ADDR = #{fullAddr} WHERE USER_ID = #{userId}
mapper.select: SELECT PET_NO AS petNo, PET_NAME AS petName, SPECIES AS species, BREED AS breed, BIRTHDATE AS birthdate, GENDER AS gender, IS_MAIN AS isMain FROM pet WHERE USER_ID = #{userId} ORDER BY PET_NO DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO pet ( USER_ID, PET_NAME, SPECIES, BREED, BIRTHDATE, GENDER, IS_MAIN ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{petName}, #{species}, #{breed}, #{birthdate}, #{gender}, 'N' )
mapper.select: SELECT RSV_NO AS rsvNo, DATE_FORMAT(RSV_DATE, '%Y-%m-%d') AS rsvDate, DATE_FORMAT(RSV_START_TIME, '%H:%i') AS rsvStartTime, DATE_FORMAT(RSV_END_TIME, '%H:%i') AS rsvEndTime, PET_NO AS petNo, RSV_STATUS AS rsvStatus FROM reservation WHERE USER_ID = #{userId} ORDER BY RSV_DATE DESC, RSV_START_TIME DESC LIMIT 5

SELECT R.RSV_NO AS rsvNo, R.SLOT_NO AS slotNo, DATE_FORMAT(R.RSV_DATE, '%Y-%m-%d') AS rsvDate, DATE_FORMAT(R.RSV_START_TIME, '%H:%i') AS rsvStartTime, DATE_FORMAT(R.RSV_END_TIME, '%H:%i') AS rsvEndTime,
R.STORE_NO AS storeNo, S.STORE_NAME AS storeName,
R.USER_ID AS userId, R.PET_NO AS petNo, P.PET_NAME AS petName,
R.MENU_NO AS menuNo, R.IS_EXTERNAL AS isExternal, IFNULL(R.REQUEST, '') AS request,
R.RSV_STATUS AS rsvStatus,
DATE_FORMAT(R.CDATE, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS cdate,
CASE WHEN RV.REVIEW_NO IS NOT NULL THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS reviewYn
FROM ( SELECT * FROM ( SELECT R.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY R.USER_ID, R.STORE_NO, R.PET_NO, R.RSV_DATE, R.RSV_START_TIME, R.RSV_END_TIME ORDER BY CASE WHEN R.RSV_STATUS = 'CAN' THEN 1 WHEN R.RSV_STATUS = 'CNF' THEN 2 WHEN R.RSV_STATUS = 'FIN' THEN 3 WHEN R.RSV_STATUS = 'WAI' THEN 4 ELSE 5 END, R.RSV_NO DESC ) AS rn FROM RESERVATION R WHERE R.USER_ID = #{userId} ) X WHERE X.rn = 1 ) R
LEFT JOIN STORE S ON R.STORE_NO = S.STORE_NO
LEFT JOIN PET P ON R.PET_NO = P.PET_NO
LEFT JOIN ( SELECT RSV_NO, USER_ID, MAX(REVIEW_NO) AS REVIEW_NO FROM REVIEW WHERE RSV_NO IS NOT NULL GROUP BY RSV_NO, USER_ID ) RV ON R.RSV_NO = RV.RSV_NO AND R.USER_ID = RV.USER_ID
ORDER BY R.RSV_DATE DESC, R.RSV_START_TIME ASC, R.RSV_NO DESC

SELECT o.ORD_NO AS orderNo, DATE_FORMAT(o.ORD_DATE, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS orderDate,
od.ORD_DETAIL_NO AS orderDetailNo, od.PRODUCT_NO AS productNo, p.PRODUCT_NAME AS productName,
CONCAT(pf.FILE_PATH, '/', pf.FILE_NAME) AS productImg,
od.ORD_QTY AS qty, od.UNIT_PRICE AS price,
o.ORD_STATUS AS payStatus, o.DELI_STATUS AS deliStatus,
CASE WHEN r.REVIEW_NO IS NOT NULL THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS reviewYn
FROM ORDERS o
JOIN ORDER_DETAIL od ON o.ORD_NO = od.ORD_NO
JOIN PRODUCT p ON od.PRODUCT_NO = p.PRODUCT_NO
LEFT JOIN PRODUCT_FILE pf ON od.PRODUCT_NO = pf.PRODUCT_NO AND pf.FILE_NO = ( SELECT MIN(pf2.FILE_NO) FROM PRODUCT_FILE pf2 WHERE pf2.PRODUCT_NO = od.PRODUCT_NO )
LEFT JOIN REVIEW r ON od.ORD_NO = r.ORD_NO AND od.PRODUCT_NO = r.PRODUCT_NO
WHERE o.USER_ID = #{userId}
ORDER BY o.ORD_DATE DESC, o.ORD_NO DESC, od.ORD_DETAIL_NO ASC

SELECT w.WEIGHT_NO AS id, w.PET_NO AS petNo, p.PET_NAME AS petName, w.WEIGHT AS weight, DATE_FORMAT(w.CDATE, '%Y-%m-%d') AS date FROM PET_WEIGHT w JOIN PET p ON w.PET_NO = p.PET_NO WHERE w.PET_NO = #{petNo} ORDER BY w.CDATE ASC, w.WEIGHT_NO ASC

SELECT h.HEALTH_NO AS id, h.PET_NO AS petNo, p.PET_NAME AS petName, h.TITLE AS title, h.RECORD_DATE AS date, h.MEMO AS memo FROM PET_HEALTH h JOIN PET p ON h.PET_NO = p.PET_NO WHERE h.PET_NO = #{petNo} ORDER BY h.RECORD_DATE DESC, h.CDATE DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO PET_HEALTH ( PET_NO, TITLE, RECORD_DATE, MEMO ) VALUES ( #{petNo}, #{title}, #{date}, #{memo} )
mapper.select: SELECT v.VAC_NO AS id, v.PET_NO AS petNo, p.PET_NAME AS petName, v.VAC_NAME AS name, v.VAC_DATE AS date, v.NEXT_VAC_DATE AS nextDate, v.HOSPITAL_NAME AS hospitalName FROM PET_VACCINE v JOIN PET p ON v.PET_NO = p.PET_NO WHERE v.PET_NO = #{petNo} ORDER BY v.VAC_DATE DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO pet_vaccine ( PET_NO, VAC_NAME, VAC_DATE, NEXT_VAC_DATE, HOSPITAL_NAME, MEMO ) VALUES ( #{petNo}, #{name}, #{date}, #{nextDate}, #{hospitalName}, #{memo} )
mapper.select: SELECT B.BOARD_NO AS id, B.BOARD_NO AS boardNo, B.TITLE AS title, B.B_CONTENT AS content, B.CREATE_TIME AS cdate, CASE B.B_SUB_NO WHEN 1 THEN '자유게시판' WHEN 2 THEN '질문게시판' WHEN 3 THEN '후기게시판' ELSE '커뮤니티' END AS boardName FROM BOARD B WHERE B.USER_ID = #{userId} AND B.B_STATUS = 'Y' ORDER BY B.CREATE_TIME DESC

SELECT C.COMMENT_NO AS id, C.C_CONTENT AS content, C.CREATE_TIME AS cdate, C.BOARD_NO AS boardNo, B.TITLE AS postTitle, CASE B.B_SUB_NO WHEN 1 THEN '자유게시판' WHEN 2 THEN '질문게시판' WHEN 3 THEN '후기게시판' ELSE '커뮤니티' END AS boardName FROM `COMMENT` C JOIN BOARD B ON C.BOARD_NO = B.BOARD_NO WHERE C.USER_ID = #{userId} AND B.B_STATUS = 'Y' ORDER BY C.CREATE_TIME DESC

SELECT SUB_NO AS subNo, '프리미엄 구독' AS planName, DATE_FORMAT(S_DATE, '%Y-%m-%d') AS startDate, DATE_FORMAT(E_DATE, '%Y-%m-%d') AS endDate, SUB_PRICE AS subPrice,
CASE WHEN E_DATE >= NOW() THEN '이용중' ELSE '만료' END AS status,
IS_AUTO AS isAuto, METHOD_NO AS methodNo, DATE_FORMAT(N_DATE, '%Y-%m-%d') AS nextBillingDate, DATE_FORMAT(N_DATE, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS nextBillingRaw,
CASE WHEN DATE_SUB(N_DATE, INTERVAL 1 DAY) >= NOW() THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS canChangeAuto
FROM subscription WHERE USER_ID = #{userId} ORDER BY SUB_NO DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT SUB_NO AS subNo, USER_ID AS userId, METHOD_NO AS methodNo, DATE_FORMAT(S_DATE, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS startDate, DATE_FORMAT(E_DATE, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS endDate, DATE_FORMAT(N_DATE, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS nextBillingDate, SUB_PRICE AS subPrice, SUB_STATUS AS subStatus, IS_AUTO AS isAuto, CASE WHEN E_DATE >= NOW() THEN '이용중' ELSE '만료' END AS statusText, CASE WHEN IS_AUTO = 'Y' THEN '자동결제' ELSE '수동/해지' END AS autoText FROM subscription WHERE USER_ID = #{userId} ORDER BY SUB_NO DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE subscription SET SUB_STATUS = 'N', IS_AUTO = 'N' WHERE USER_ID = #{userId} AND SUB_STATUS = 'Y'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO review ( USER_ID, PRODUCT_NO, ORD_NO, RATING, R_CONTENTS ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{productNo}, #{ordNo}, #{rating}, #{content} )
mapper.select: SELECT IFNULL(SUM(POINT_AMOUNT), 0) AS point FROM USER_POINT WHERE USER_ID = #{userId}

SELECT POINT_NO AS pointNo, USER_ID AS userId, POINT_AMOUNT AS pointAmount, ORD_NO AS ordNo, REVIEW_NO AS reviewNo, DATE_FORMAT(CDATE, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS cdate FROM USER_POINT WHERE USER_ID = #{userId} ORDER BY CDATE DESC

SELECT uc.UCP_NO AS couponNo, uc.USER_ID AS userId, uc.COUPON_NO AS couponNoRef,
c.COUPON_NAME AS couponName, c.CP_CONTENTS AS cpContents, c.DEDUCEPRICE AS discountAmt,
uc.CP_STATUS AS cpStatus, uc.CDATE AS startDate, uc.EXP_DATE AS endDate, uc.USE_DATE AS useDate FROM USER_COUPON uc JOIN COUPON c ON uc.COUPON_NO = c.COUPON_NO WHERE uc.USER_ID = #{userId} ORDER BY uc.EXP_DATE ASC
